name: @concord-ai/mcp
description: Concord is a self-hosted platform that allows you to easily connect your data sources to any AI model and build powerful AI-driven workflows.

CONCORD_PORT.description: The port to run the Concord server on. Defaults to 8787.

CONCORD_CONFIG_PATH.description: The path to the Concord config file. Defaults to ./config.yml.

CONCORD_DB_URL.description: The URL of the database to use. Defaults to file:./concord.db.

CONCORD_LOG_LEVEL.description: The log level to use. Defaults to info.

CONCORD_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: The default model to use for AI tasks. Defaults to openai:gpt-4o-mini.

CONCORD_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_TELEMETRY.description: Whether to allow anonymous telemetry. Defaults to true.

uvx.description: Run Concord using uvx, the Universal CLI.
